note: THE RECORDED SHAPE OF THE THIRD GENERATION FIREBIRD (Lane B, lane-b-variant-split, Nov 17 2026): counts and prices only, no listing text, no seller. RECORDED is what production answered for crew on Nov 17 2026 (variantSplit.why on 928e39e9: the census of the unstated car over 1982 to 1992, five years) and what the answer's own variant list counted (176 sales). WORLD is a sales archive built to that shape: each window is n sales spread over the quartiles given (min and max a little outside p25 and p75), dated between the months given, in the years given.
